summary:
PROJECT: LUNAR is an interactive educational space mission game designed to introduce children aged 7–12 to the science and challenges of living beyond Earth. Set in a futuristic lunar research base, players step into the role of an astronaut trainee and take on five essential missions: Food Production, Radiation Shielding, Communication Delay, Power Supply, and Life Support.

Guided by a fellow astronaut, players manage hands-on mini-games, solve practical challenges, and discover the science behind real NASA technologies and space exploration. Every mission turns complex scientific concepts into engaging, interactive experiences that encourage curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving.

Built by IRONBLOOD, PROJECT: LUNAR aims to make space science accessible, exciting, and memorable, inspiring the next generation to look beyond Earth and imagine what's possible.
details:
PROJECT: LUNAR is an interactive educational video game designed to introduce children aged 7–12 to space science, astronaut training, and the challenges of living on the Moon. Set in a futuristic lunar research base, players take on the role of an astronaut trainee guided by a fellow astronaut throughout five essential missions: Food Production, Radiation Shielding, Communication Delay, Power Supply, and Life Support.

Each mission features a unique mini-game that allows players to solve practical challenges while learning the scientific principles behind real space exploration technologies. For example, players grow crops in a simulated lunar greenhouse, design radiation protection for a habitat, coordinate a rover while accounting for communication delays, distribute limited electrical power, and manage essential life-support systems. NASA-related facts and scientific explanations are integrated into the gameplay to connect virtual experiences with real-world research.

The project's primary benefit is making complex scientific concepts accessible and engaging for young learners. Rather than relying on traditional text-based learning, PROJECT: LUNAR uses interactive problem-solving, visual storytelling, and immediate feedback to encourage curiosity, critical thinking, and scientific literacy. Its intended impact is to inspire children to explore STEM fields and develop an early interest in space exploration.

The game is being developed using Visual Studio, with HTML, CSS, JAVASCRIPT and supporting design and development software such as Visual Studio and Vercel. The project combines educational game design, interactive simulations, character development, and visual storytelling.

Its creativity lies in transforming five real challenges of lunar exploration into an interconnected astronaut training experience. Players do not simply memorize scientific facts; they apply knowledge, make decisions, encounter challenges, and learn from their mistakes. Our team considered the target age group, scientific accuracy, accessibility, gameplay difficulty, visual engagement, and the balance between entertainment and education. We also considered how the five mission systems depend on one another, reflecting the complexity of sustaining human life beyond Earth.

Through PROJECT: LUNAR, IRONBLOOD aims to turn curiosity about space into an interactive learning journey and empower the next generation of explorers.
